queries.name: Agents, Agent Pools, and Host Servers
queries.description: Lists Okta agents, their associated agent pools, and the AD servers hosting each agent.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta_AgentPool)<-[:Okta_AgentMemberOf|Okta_HostsAgent*1..2]-(agent)
WHERE agent:Okta_Agent OR agent:Computer
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Principals with Admin Console Access
queries.description: Identifies principals with access to the Okta Admin Console.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta)-[:Okta_AppAssignment]->(console:Okta_Application)
WHERE console.name = "saasure"
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Application Assignments
queries.description: List all application assignments.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta)-[:Okta_AppAssignment]->(:Okta_Application)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Application Credentials
queries.description: Lists all service application secrets and JWTs.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta_Application)<-[:Okta_SecretOf|Okta_KeyOf]->(credential)
WHERE credential:Okta_ClientSecret OR credential:Okta_JWK
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Devices
queries.description: List all devices, their owners, and any mobile admins.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Device)-[:Okta_DeviceOf]->(:Okta_User)
OPTIONAL MATCH adminPath = (admin)-[:Okta_MobileAdmin]->(:Okta_Device)
WHERE admin:Okta_User OR admin:Okta_Group OR admin:Okta_Application
RETURN path,adminPath
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Group Membership
queries.description: Retrieves all group membership relationships.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_User)-[:Okta_MemberOf]->(:Okta_Group)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Hybrid Relationships Inbound
queries.description: Retrieves all hybrid relationships from external systems to Okta.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (source)-[]->(:Okta)
WHERE NOT source:Okta
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Hybrid Relationships Outbound
queries.description: Retrieves all hybrid relationships from Okta to external systems.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta)-[]->(target)
WHERE NOT target:Okta
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Security Principal Synchronization
queries.description: Retrieves all users and groups that are synchronized TO or FROM Okta.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta)-[:Okta_UserPull|Okta_UserPush|Okta_GroupPull|Okta_GroupPush]->(:Okta)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Identity Provider Assignments - Direct Privileged Access
queries.description: Identity providers associated with users or groups that hold direct privileged role assignments in Okta.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta_IdentityProvider)-[:Okta_IdentityProviderFor|Okta_IdpGroupAssignment]->(assignee)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE assignee:Okta_User OR assignee:Okta_Group
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Identity Provider Assignments - Indirect Privileged Access
queries.description: Identity providers associated with users who hold privileged role assignments through group membership in Okta.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta_IdentityProvider)-[:Okta_IdentityProviderFor]->(:Okta_User)-[:Okta_MemberOf]->(:Okta_Group)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Identity Provider Assignments
queries.description: Lists all identity providers and the users and groups they are associated with, including per-user trust relationships and automatic group assignments.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta_IdentityProvider)-[:Okta_IdentityProviderFor|Okta_IdpGroupAssignment]->(assignee)
WHERE assignee:Okta_User OR assignee:Okta_Group
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Organizational Structure
queries.description: Retrieves all manager relationships.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_User)-[:Okta_ManagerOf]->(:Okta_User)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Org Trust Relationships
queries.description: Lists all org-to-org trust relationships including inbound and outbound SSO federation, Secure Web Authentication (SWA), and Kerberos SSO relationships between Okta applications and supported external organizations or tenants.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (source)-[:Okta_InboundOrgSSO|Okta_OutboundOrgSSO|Okta_OrgSWA|Okta_KerberosSSO]-()
WHERE source:Okta_Application OR source:Okta_IdentityProvider
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Password and MFA Permissions
queries.description: Lists permissions to reset passwords and MFA factors.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(actor)-[:Okta_ResetPassword|Okta_ResetFactors|Okta_HelpDeskAdmin|Okta_OrgAdmin|Okta_GroupAdmin]->(:Okta_User)
WHERE actor:Okta_User OR actor:Okta_Group OR actor:Okta_Application
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Policy Mappings
queries.description: Retrieves all policy mappings.
queries.query:
MATCH policies = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta_Policy)
MATCH mappings = (:Okta_Policy)-[:Okta_PolicyMapping]->(:Okta)
RETURN policies,mappings
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Unrotated Active Access Keys on Privileged Apps
queries.description: Finds active JWKs or client secrets older than 365 days on applications that have role assignments.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (credential)-[:Okta_KeyOf|Okta_SecretOf]->(:Okta_Application)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE (credential:Okta_JWK OR credential:Okta_ClientSecret) AND credential.status = "ACTIVE" AND datetime(credential.created) <= datetime() - duration("P365D")
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Applications with Role Assignments
queries.description: Applications that have roles assigned.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta_Application)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Synced Principals with Privileged Access (Direct) - Hybrid Edges
queries.description: Users, groups, and applications with inbound hybrid relationships (sync, SSO, or AD agent) that hold privileged role assignments in Okta.
queries.query:
MATCH path = ()-[:Okta_UserSync|Okta_MembershipSync|Okta_InboundSSO|Okta_HostsAgent]->(principal)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE principal:Okta_User OR principal:Okta_Group OR principal:Okta_Application
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Synced Principals with Privileged Access (Indirect) - Hybrid Edges
queries.description: Users and applications with inbound hybrid relationships (sync, SSO, or AD agent) that hold privileged role assignments through group membership in Okta.
queries.query:
MATCH path = ()-[:Okta_UserSync|Okta_InboundSSO|Okta_HostsAgent]->(principal)-[:Okta_MemberOf]->(:Okta_Group)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE principal:Okta_User OR principal:Okta_Application
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Synced Principals with Privileged Access (Direct) - Okta Edges
queries.description: Users and groups synchronized from external sources that have privileged role assignments.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(provider)-[:Okta_UserPull|Okta_GroupPull|Okta_IdentityProviderFor|Okta_IdpGroupAssignment]->(:Okta)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE provider:Okta_Application OR provider:Okta_IdentityProvider
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Synced Principals with Privileged Access (Indirect) - Okta Edges
queries.description: Users synchronized from external sources that hold privileged role assignments through group membership in Okta.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(provider)-[:Okta_UserPull|Okta_IdentityProviderFor]->(:Okta_User)-[:Okta_MemberOf]->(:Okta_Group)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE provider:Okta_Application OR provider:Okta_IdentityProvider
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Privileged Users without MFA (Direct)
queries.description: Finds users who do not have multi-factor authentication enabled and directly hold privileged role assignments.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (user:Okta_User)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE user.authentication_factors = 0
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Privileged Users without MFA (Indirect)
queries.description: Finds users who do not have multi-factor authentication enabled and hold privileged role assignments through group membership.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (user:Okta_User)-[:Okta_MemberOf]->(:Okta_Group)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE user.authentication_factors = 0
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Privileged Users with Old Passwords (Direct)
queries.description: Finds users whose last password change was more than a year ago and directly hold privileged role assignments.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (user:Okta_User)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE user.password_changed IS NOT NULL AND datetime(user.password_changed) <= datetime() - duration("P365D")
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Privileged Users with Old Passwords (Indirect)
queries.description: Finds users whose last password change was more than a year ago and hold privileged role assignments through group membership.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (user:Okta_User)-[:Okta_MemberOf]->(:Okta_Group)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE user.password_changed IS NOT NULL AND datetime(user.password_changed) <= datetime() - duration("P365D")
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Privileged Users with Non-Active Status (Direct)
queries.description: Finds users whose status is not ACTIVE and directly hold privileged role assignments, including deactivated, suspended, or provisioning-incomplete accounts.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (user:Okta_User)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE user.status <> "ACTIVE"
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Privileged Users with Non-Active Status (Indirect)
queries.description: Finds users whose status is not ACTIVE and hold privileged role assignments through group membership, including deactivated, suspended, or provisioning-incomplete accounts.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (user:Okta_User)-[:Okta_MemberOf]->(:Okta_Group)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE user.status <> "ACTIVE"
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Read Client Secrets of Privileged Applications
queries.description: Searches for client secrets associated with privileged applications that are readable to non-Super Admins.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta)-[:Okta_ReadClientSecret|Okta_MemberOf*1..2]->(:Okta_ClientSecret)-[:Okta_SecretOf]->(:Okta_Application)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Realm Membership
queries.description: Lists all Okta realms and the users assigned to them.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta_Realm)-[:Okta_RealmContains]->(:Okta_User)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Resource Set Membership
queries.description: Lists all resource sets and their direct and indirect members.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta_ResourceSet)-[:Okta_ResourceSetContains|Okta_ResourceSetContainsMembersOf|Okta_ResourceSetContainsIndirect]->(:Okta)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Application Administrators and Managers
queries.description: List all Application Administrators and Managers.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(admin)-[:Okta_AppAdmin|Okta_ManageApp]->(app)
WHERE (admin:Okta_User OR admin:Okta_Group OR admin:Okta_Application) AND (app:Okta_Application OR app:Okta_ApiServiceIntegration)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Role Assignments - Role Assignments and Scope
queries.description: Lists all role assignments and scope, including transitive group membership.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment|Okta_MemberOf*1..2]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Role Assignments - All Custom Roles
queries.description: Lists all role assignments, linking principals to their assigned custom roles.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(assignee)-[:Okta_HasRole]->(:Okta_CustomRole)
WHERE assignee:Okta_User OR assignee:Okta_Group OR assignee:Okta_Application
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Role Assignments - All Built-in Roles
queries.description: Lists all role assignments, linking principals to their assigned built-in roles.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(assignee)-[:Okta_HasRole]->(:Okta_Role)
WHERE assignee:Okta_User OR assignee:Okta_Group OR assignee:Okta_Application
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Role Assignments - Group Administrators
queries.description: List all Group Administrators and Group Membership Administrators.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(admin)-[:Okta_GroupAdmin|Okta_GroupMembershipAdmin|Okta_OrgAdmin]->(:Okta_Group)
WHERE admin:Okta_User OR admin:Okta_Group OR admin:Okta_Application
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: SCIM Apps Receiving Password Updates
queries.description: Lists application-to-user assignments where the app receives password updates.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta_Application)-[:Okta_ReadPasswordUpdates]->(:Okta_User)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: API Service Integration Creators
queries.description: Lists all API service integrations and their creators.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_Organization)-[:Okta_Contains]->(:Okta)-[:Okta_CreatorOf]->(:Okta_ApiServiceIntegration)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Stale Privileged Users (Direct)
queries.description: Finds user accounts that have not logged in for at least 180 days and directly hold privileged role assignments.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (user:Okta_User)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE user.last_login IS NULL OR datetime(user.last_login) <= datetime() - duration("P180D")
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Stale Privileged Users (Indirect)
queries.description: Finds user accounts that have not logged in for at least 180 days and hold privileged role assignments through group membership.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (user:Okta_User)-[:Okta_MemberOf]->(:Okta_Group)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment]->(:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta)
WHERE user.last_login IS NULL OR datetime(user.last_login) <= datetime() - duration("P180D")
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Secure Web Authentication Applications
queries.description: Secure Web Authentication (SWA) relationships between Okta users and their linked accounts in external applications.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_User)-[:Okta_SWA]->(target)
WHERE NOT target:Okta
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Inbound User and Group Synchronization
queries.description: Lists all inbound user and group synchronization relationships to Okta, including password synchronization across Org2Org setups.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (source)-[:Okta_UserSync|Okta_MembershipSync|Okta_PasswordSync]->(target)
WHERE target:Okta_User OR target:Okta_Group
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Outbound User and Group Synchronization
queries.description: Lists all outbound user and group synchronization relationships from Okta, including password synchronization across Org2Org setups.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (source)-[:Okta_UserSync|Okta_MembershipSync|Okta_PasswordSync]->(target)
WHERE source:Okta_User OR source:Okta_Group
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Tier Zero Principals and Devices
queries.description: Principals with SUPER_ADMIN or ORG_ADMIN role assignments and their associated devices.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta)-[:Okta_HasRoleAssignment|Okta_MemberOf|Okta_DeviceOf*1..3]->(role:Okta_RoleAssignment)-[:Okta_ScopedTo]->(:Okta_Organization)
WHERE role.type = "SUPER_ADMIN"
OR role.type = "ORG_ADMIN"
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000

queries.name: Users with API Tokens
queries.description: Retrieves all (privileged) users who have been assigned API tokens.
queries.query:
MATCH path = (:Okta_ApiToken)-[:Okta_ApiTokenFor]->(:Okta_User)<-[:Okta_Contains]-(:Okta_Organization)
RETURN path
LIMIT 1000
